import napari
from qtpy.QtWidgets import QApplication
from napari_dare3d import _api as api
from napari_dare3d._scale import resolve_source_scale_xyz,movie_fallback_scale_xyz
from napari_dare3d._widget import _result_layer_scale
from napari_dare3d._release_models import release_segmentation_scale_mode
r=json.loads((out/'archived_archived.json').read_text())
centers=np.array(r['pred_centers_txyz'])
det=[api._center_to_detection((0,*c)) for c in centers]
viewer=napari.Viewer(show=False)
im=viewer.add_image(tifffile.imread(movies['movie_I2'][0]),name='movie_I2')
layers=api.to_layer_data(det,layer_scale=_result_layer_scale(im,im.data.ndim))
points=viewer.add_points(layers[0][0],**layers[0][1])
app=QApplication.instance()
def scan(scale):
    im.scale=scale; points.scale=_result_layer_scale(im,4)
    rows=[]; union=set()
    for t in range(21):
        for z in range(10):
            viewer.dims.set_current_step(0,t)
            viewer.dims.set_current_step(1,z)
            app.processEvents()
            ids=[int(i) for i in points._indices_view]
            union.update(ids)
            rows.append({'t':t,'z':z,'count':len(ids),'ids':ids})
    probes=[0,len(points.data)//2,len(points.data)-1]
    errors=[float(np.max(np.abs(np.array(im.data_to_world(points.data[i]))-np.array(points.data_to_world(points.data[i]))))) for i in probes]
    return {'scale':list(scale),'image_scale':list(im.scale),'points_scale':list(points.scale),'image_translate':list(im.translate),'points_translate':list(points.translate),'out_of_slice_display':points.out_of_slice_display,'total_centers':len(points.data),'unique_visible_across_all_slices':len(union),'max_visible_single_slice':max(v['count'] for v in rows),'landmark_world_errors':errors,'slices':rows,'dimension_order':list(viewer.dims.order)}
initial=scan((1,1,1,1))
calibrated=scan((1,1,0.208,0.208))
record={'napari_version':napari.__version__,'controlled_viewer':True,'live_user_viewer_modified':False,'image_shape':list(im.data.shape),'array_unchanged_by_calibration':np.array_equal(im.data,tifffile.imread(movies['movie_I2'][0])),'point_conversion_max_error':float(np.max(np.abs(points.data-centers[:,[0,3,2,1]]))),'movie_I2_scale_table_result':resolve_source_scale_xyz('movie_I2',str(repo/'data/3D/scales.json')),'movie_I2_fallback':movie_fallback_scale_xyz('movie_I2'),'promoted_path_mode':release_segmentation_scale_mode('neural_tube',ckpt),'same_hash_legacy_path_mode':release_segmentation_scale_mode('neural_tube',legacy/'checkpoints/epoch_057.ckpt'),'unit_display':initial,'manuscript_spacing_display':calibrated}
save('display.json',record)
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ('unit_display','manuscript_spacing_display')},default=plain),flush=True)
for label,v in [('unit',initial),('calibrated',calibrated)]:
    print(label,{k:v[k] for k in ('total_centers','unique_visible_across_all_slices','max_visible_single_slice','landmark_world_errors')},flush=True)
viewer.close()
